reason: I already have my Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out, so I'm not going to switch just because of one video. My doctor did say my magnesium could be low, but I'd ask her what to take first, and 30 foil sachets a month feels like a lot of trash.
objection: Thirty single-use foil sachets every month is a lot of packaging waste, and I already have a supplement I trust and reorder.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor's blood test confirmed low magnesium and she told me to take this type, and the sachets were recyclable or there was a refill pouch option.
